summary: Regression retest after MongoDB backfill/seed changes to job_search_logs review fields and removal of leftover tscheck fixtures. All 8 reused browser checks pass (1 required a small adaptation to the with_file=0 data reality, which is an intentional spec deviation, not a bug). Backend suite: 18/22 pass, 4 pre-existing test_error failures matching the briefing's known KeyError:'id' issue. Found and cleaned up ONE piece of genuine pre-existing residue (a stray tscheck job log on Sarah's account, +1 extra pending row) that the briefing claimed was already removed - documented as a note/bug below.

bugs.title: Leftover tscheck job-search log on sarah@hves.com.au survived the claimed cleanup
bugs.description: Before this run, GET /api/evidence/{staff_id} returned 36 rows (not the expected 35) with pending=15/approved=21, and sarah@hves.com.au had 5 job logs / 35 PBAS points instead of the documented 4 logs / 25 points. The extra row (id d5b26093-..., employer_name 'tscheck-employer-0375e0cd', notes 'created by automated test') was residue from a prior test run that the briefing said had been removed. Cleaned it up directly in MongoDB (job_search_logs) as part of this retest so the acceptance-matrix baseline (35 rows, pending=14/approved=21/flagged=0, sarah=4 logs/25 points) could be verified; post-cleanup all counts matched exactly.
bugs.evidence: curl GET /api/evidence/user-owner-system before cleanup: 36 rows, Counter({'approved':21,'pending':15}); one row had employer_name='tscheck-employer-0375e0cd', participant_id='user-participant-sarah'. After deleting that one doc from job_search_logs: 35 rows, Counter({'approved':21,'pending':14}); sarah dashboard pbas_points=25, len(recent_logs)=4.

action_items.detail: 4 pre-existing backend test files fail with KeyError:'id' on stale schema expectations (test_tscheck_admin_analytics_users.py::test_invite_new_user_added, test_deactivate_user_flips_status, test_tscheck_ai_interview_flow.py::test_full_interview_session_produces_scorecard, test_tscheck_module_quiz.py::test_quiz_submission_scores_and_completes_module). Confirmed as known/expected per briefing spec_deviations - not an application bug. No action needed on app code.

coach-evidence-review-actions previously assumed at least one evidence row had a real uploaded file (to exercise the download endpoint). Since all 35 backfilled rows now have evidence_size=0 by design (spec deviation), the check was rewritten to skip the forced-download assertion and instead confirm download buttons are disabled when no file is attached, falling back to the real download path only if a file-bearing row exists. Approve/flag flow assertions are unchanged and still pass.

learner-job-log-file-upload-points creates a real job log with a file for sarah@hves.com.au but has no way to delete it afterward - the app exposes no DELETE /api/participants/{pid}/job-logs/{id} endpoint. The check's own residue was cleaned up manually via MongoDB after this run (sarah confirmed back to 4 logs / 25 points). Since this check must re-run cleanly for the 20-logs-per-month cap criterion, consider adding a delete/cleanup endpoint, or accept that this check will need periodic manual cleanup until then.
